question: What is the broadest independently stated structured class in which nontrivial operations are invariant under admissible recoding, without assuming RCCD components?

broadness_policy.reason: Broadest is undefined until a comparison order and admissible recodings are fixed.
broadness_policy.scope_criterion: A system is included exactly when its typed steps have identities and associative sequential composition.

axioms.statement: Every step has a source interface and a target interface.
Every interface has an identity step.
Whenever the target of one step equals the source of another, their sequential composite exists.
Identity steps are two-sided units and sequential composition is associative.

input_operation_schema.input: a finite directed graph G with distinguished vertices s and t
input_operation_schema.presentation: a graph map from G into the underlying graph of a small category C
input_operation_schema.output: an arrow from the image of s to the image of t
input_operation_schema.invariance: for every functor H:C->D, H(alpha_C(x)) = alpha_D(H composed with x)

theorem_claims.statement: TC1-TC4 characterize small categories and functors as the corresponding recodings.
Every finitary arrow-valued operation invariant under all functors is evaluation of one fixed path in the free category on its input graph; conversely every such path defines an invariant operation.
Identity and sequential composition are common nontrivial invariants whenever the input graph contains a genuinely composable chain.
No RCCD-specific generator, operator, observation, objective, or decomposition follows from typed composition alone.

terminal_disposition.strongest_claim: Across all small typed compositional systems and all functorial recodings, the complete finitary arrow-valued invariant operations are path terms generated by identities and sequential composition.
terminal_disposition.remaining_question: Whether RCCD or another richer basis is necessary, economical, or Pareto-optimal for the separately chosen explicitly auditable-artifact class remains empirical and open.

nonclaims: small categories are the absolute broadest possible class of every conceivable reasoning system
typed composition is a complete architecture of reasoning
RCCD is necessary, minimal, unique, or Pareto-optimal
the clean-room target-category study has been executed
the result changes accepted Project FAR theory
